data.name: Eva
data.gender_notes: Eva is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Ḥawwah, associated with ḥayah, 'to live' (Genesis 3:20). Its root is Hebrew ḥ-w-h. Eve, the first woman (Genesis 3:20). Eva is a Hebrew name meaning “Life; living”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Eva expresses “Life; living”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Ḥawwah, associated with ḥayah, 'to live' (Genesis 3:20).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eva total 10, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
